import numpy as np
def equation(t,P,params):
    a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h,w,q=params[0],params[1],params[2],params[3],params[4],params[5],params[6],params[7],params[8],params[9]
    s=np.sin(w*t); co=np.cos(w*t); ed=np.exp(-q*t)
    return a*t + b*P*np.log(P) + (c + d*t + e*s + f*co + g*ed + h*t**2*ed + 0.0*t)/P + params[2]*0 + (-0.0196600)*t**2/P
